title: 8 small things that make a man look *sharp*

items.head: Stand like you belong there
items.sub: Chin level, shoulders back. Posture is the first thing people read.

items.head: Hold eye contact one beat longer
items.sub: Looking away first reads as nervous. Let them look away.

items.head: Speak slower than feels natural
items.sub: Fast talkers sound anxious. Pauses sound certain.

items.head: Phone face down when someone talks
items.sub: Full attention is rare enough to feel like respect.

items.head: Wear clothes that fit
items.sub: A fitted cheap shirt beats a baggy expensive one. Go down a size.

items.head: Sleep 8 hours, drink water
items.sub: Clear skin and alert eyes do more than any product.

items.head: Firm handshake, then let go
items.sub: Two pumps. Not a dead fish, not a crusher.

items.head: Say less about yourself
items.sub: Ask one more question than you answer. People remember how you made them feel.

head: Looking sharp is *habits,* not money.
sub: Start with #1 today. It costs nothing.
